content_zh:
“好香好香，什么味道。”
睡梦中，较小的女子喃喃自语，肚子咕咕乱叫起来。
最后实在是忍不住，两眼睁开，伸了个懒腰，细长的手臂就如两根玉葱一样，洁白无瑕，“睡的好舒服啊。”
她眼神一怔，“我不是中了炼血迷魂烟吗？我怎么会在这里？”
看到两名师姐，立刻爬起来跑上去，摇着一位师姐，道：“师姐，师姐，快醒醒，快醒醒，我们可能被炼血宗的人抓住了。”
‘炼血宗’这三个字带着恐惧，深深的刺激着她们的神经。
刹那间就醒了过来，并且身体微微卷缩了一下。
大师姐迅速捡起地上的寒剑，看了一眼山洞环境，重重的呼出一口气，道：“小师妹，你要吓死我啊，这里是我们昨天躲避的山洞。”
“啊？”
“是昨天躲避的山洞呀？”小师妹挠挠头，道：“我怎么不记得了？”
二师姐说道：“你当然不记得了，你进入山洞前就昏迷了，还不是我一直背着你。”
小师妹立即扑了上去，在二师姐脸颊上重重的亲了一下，“二师姐对我最好，嘻嘻……”
“昨天晚上发生了什么？”二师姐将小师妹推开，看着大师姐，脑海中在回忆，喃喃道：“我记得山洞中还有个小子吧？”
大师姐点点头，想了一下脑袋有些疼，炼血迷魂烟的后遗症，道：“我昏迷之前看着他站在洞口，好像是在保护我们，不知道他怎么样了。”
小师妹凑上来，道：“小子，是什么小子？是帅哥吗？哇塞，英雄救美啊，这么激情的好戏我怎么错过了呢，哎呀，真是讨厌，英雄救美啊，你们有没有以身相许啊？”
大师姐看着二师姐，笑道：“师妹，你昨天晚上说什么来着，谁救了你，你就嫁给谁吧？”
二师姐也打趣道：“我在昏迷中也听到师姐说过这样的话哦。”
小师妹有些沮丧道：“我竟然错过了，我真想看看那小子长什么样，要是帅哥的话，本小姐也来个以身相许，我们三姐妹嫁给同一个男人，嘻嘻……”
大师姐和二师姐两眼一瞪，小师妹立即不敢再乱说。
大师姐微微说道：“不知道他怎么样了，炼血宗的人可是心狠手辣，估计他……”

“什么味道这么香啊？”二师姐肚子咕咕叫了一声，连续逃了一晚上，肚子早就饿的乱叫。
小师妹吞着口水道：“我也闻到了，好香啊，我都受不了，我出去看看先。”
“小白，你慢点，慢点，烫啊。”龙飞连忙说道，看着小白狼将一块烤好的肉叼走。
小白熟练的将烤肉抽了出来，正想一口吞下去的时候，看到洞口站在一个亭亭玉立的少女。
十五六岁的样子，一声白色连衣裙，脸色带着恬静。
两只眼睛水汪汪透着灵气，身穿更是好的没话说。
标准的美女。
小白两眼发光，眼瞳都要变成‘心’字形，一下子就跳了过去，站在少女的面前，将烤肉递了上去。
“好可爱的小狗狗呀。”少女春心泛滥，直接把小白给抱起来。
听到声音，龙飞转身看去，暗自一惊，“我靠，这异界的美女还真多啊，又是一超级美女啊。”
“等等。”
“是三个超级美女，小的大萝莉型，第二个青春靓丽型，第三个则是成熟御姐型，我的天，每一个都比前世所谓的女神，明星啊要漂亮的多。”龙飞有些看不过来，脑海中也顿时想到她们昨天晚上说的话，心中暗喜道：“我性福生活就要来了，太突然了。”
昨天晚上将炼血宗弟子赶跑之后，他并没有回山洞，而是去猎杀妖兽了。
为早餐做准备。
龙飞天亮之后没有进山洞，现在他有些后悔了，不对，是非常的后悔！
以他猥琐的个性，如果知道是这些美女的话，不占点便宜那他还叫龙飞？
现在不同。
龙飞装出一副一本正经的样子，淡淡一笑，道：“你们醒了？”
“是他？”小师妹立刻盯着龙飞上下打量，而且是赤，裸裸的眼神，完全没有估计龙飞的感觉。
“长相一般嘛！”

“哎，并不是传说中的帅哥嘛，看样子英雄也不全是帅哥啊。”小师妹有些失望的说道，随后对两位师姐道：“师姐，过日子嘛，将就一点，反正在床上灯一吹黑灯瞎火看不见。”
“死丫头，说什么呢。”大师姐拧了一下小师妹的胳膊，随即对龙飞施礼，客气道：“多谢少侠相救。”

content_en:
"It smells so good, what does it smell like?"
In her sleep, the smaller woman murmured to herself, her stomach growling.
In the end, I couldn't help it anymore. I opened my eyes and stretched out. My slender arms were like two jade green onions, as white and flawless as I said, "Sleep is so comfortable."
Her eyes froze, "Didn't I get hit by the blood refining smoke? Why am I here?"
When he saw the two senior sisters, he immediately got up and ran up, shaking one senior sister and saying: "Senior sister, senior sister, wake up quickly, wake up quickly, we may have been caught by the Blood Refining Sect."
The three words 'Blood Refining Sect' were filled with fear and deeply stimulated their nerves.
He woke up in an instant, and his body curled up slightly.
The senior sister quickly picked up the cold sword on the ground, took a look at the cave environment, exhaled heavily, and said: "Little junior sister, you are going to scare me to death. This is the cave we took shelter in yesterday."
"Huh?"
"Is this the cave we hid in yesterday?" Junior Sister scratched her head and said, "Why don't I remember?"
The second senior sister said: "Of course you don't remember. You fell into a coma before entering the cave. I wasn't carrying you all the time."
The little junior sister immediately rushed forward and kissed the second senior sister hard on the cheek, "Second senior sister is the best to me, hehe..."
"What happened last night?" The second senior sister pushed the younger junior sister away, looked at the senior sister, and recalled in her mind, murmured: "I remember there was a boy in the cave, right?"
The senior sister nodded, thinking about the pain in her head and the aftereffects of the blood refining soul smoke, and said: "Before I passed out, I saw him standing at the entrance of the cave, as if he was protecting us. I don't know what happened to him."
The junior sister came up and said: "Boy, what kind of boy is he? Is he a handsome guy? Wow, the hero saves the beauty. How could I miss such a passionate show? Oh, it's really annoying. The hero saves the beauty. Have you promised me your body?"
The senior sister looked at the second senior sister and said with a smile: "Junior sister, what did you say last night? You will marry whoever saves you, right?"
The second senior sister also joked: "I also heard senior sister say such words when I was in a coma."
The junior sister was a little frustrated and said: "I actually missed it. I really want to see what that guy looks like. If he is a handsome guy, I will also come and agree with you. We three sisters will marry the same man, hehe..."
The senior elder sister and the second senior sister stared at each other, and the younger junior sister immediately did not dare to say anything nonsense.
The senior sister said slightly: "I don't know how he is. People from the Blood Refining Sect are ruthless. I guess he..."
"What smells so good?" The second senior sister's stomach growled. After running away all night, her stomach was already growling with hunger.
The junior sister swallowed her saliva and said, "I smelled it too, it smells so good that I can't stand it. I'll go out and take a look first."
"Xiao Bai, slow down, slow down, it's hot." Long Fei said quickly, watching the little white wolf take a piece of roasted meat away.
Xiaobai skillfully pulled out the roasted meat, and when he was about to swallow it, he saw a slim girl standing at the entrance of the cave.
She looked fifteen or sixteen years old, wearing a white dress and a calm expression.
Her eyes are watery and full of energy, and her clothes are even better.
Standard beauty.
Xiaobai's eyes glowed, and his pupils almost turned into the shape of 'heart'. He jumped over, stood in front of the girl, and handed over the barbecue.
"What a cute little dog." The girl was filled with love and hugged Xiaobai directly.
Hearing the voice, Long Fei turned around and was surprised, "Holy crap, there are so many beauties in this other world, and another super beauty."
"Wait."
"They are three super beauties, the small one is a big lolita type, the second one is youthful and beautiful, and the third one is a mature royal sister type. My God, each of them is much more beautiful than the so-called goddesses and celebrities in the previous life." Long Fei couldn't see it, and he immediately thought of them in his mind.What I said last night made me secretly rejoice: "My sexual life is about to come, it's so sudden."
After driving away the Blood Refining Sect disciples last night, he did not return to the cave, but went to hunt monsters.
Get ready for breakfast.
Long Fei did not enter the cave after dawn. Now he regrets it. No, he regrets it very much!
With his wretched personality, if he knew it was these beauties and didn't take advantage of them, why would he still be called Long Fei?
It's different now.
Long Fei pretended to be serious, smiled lightly, and said, "Are you awake?"
"Is it him?" The junior sister immediately stared at Long Fei and looked him up and down, and her eyes were naked, and she didn't feel that she was judging Long Fei at all.
"She looks average!"
"Hey, he is not the handsome guy in the legend. It seems that heroes are not all handsome guys." The junior sister said a little disappointed, and then said to the two senior sisters: "Senior sister, just live your life, just make do with it. Anyway, when the lamp is blown on the bed, you can't see the light."
"Damn girl, what are you talking about?" The senior sister twisted the little junior sister's arm, then saluted Long Fei and said politely: "Thank you, young hero, for saving me."
